enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a quick shower
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Wash face. Brush teeth. Turn on shower. Adjust water. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, filling a water bottle and packing lunch for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Cook breakfast on stove. Eat breakfast at table. Drink water. Fill water bottle. Pack lunch in bag. Close refrigerator.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes, checking phone for shift messages and reviewing the day's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Take off home clothes. Put on work clothes. Pick up phone. Press button. Read messages. Open calendar. Review schedule. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive to hospital. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients and handling clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient charts. Visit patients. Take vitals. Administer medication. Consult with doctors. Update records. Assist with procedures. Take break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Complete paperwork. End shift.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive home. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, drinking cold water to cool down after the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Cook dinner. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink cold water. Stand up. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up after work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on clean clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV news in the air-conditioned living room and resting during the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button on TV. Press channel button. Watch news. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put down glass. Pick up air conditioner remote. Press button. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the washing machine for laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up dirty clothes. Put clothes into machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Press power button. Select cycle. Press start button.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal tasks and watching TV while staying indoors away from the heat
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open browser. Check emails. Open document. Type notes. Pick up remote. Change TV channel. Watch TV. Continue typing. Save document. Close computer. Stand up. Walk to sofa. Sit on sofa. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, checking phone and setting an alarm for the next shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Change into pajamas. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Press button. Check messages. Open alarm app. Set alarm. Put down phone. Turn off light. Lie down.
Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep.
